units.source_text: 一提到畫，那杯喝剩下的苦艾酒就會在我眼前隱約閃現，一種焦躁的苦悶湧上心頭。啊，真想讓她看看那幾幅畫，讓她相信我繪畫的才能。

en.t: Whenever painting was mentioned, that unfinished glass of absinthe would flicker faintly before my eyes, and a restless anguish would well up in my heart. Ah, how I wanted to show her those paintings and make her believe in my talent for painting.

units.source_text: 看你一本正經地開玩笑，太可愛了。」

en.t: You are so adorable when you make jokes with such a serious face.
It was not a joke. It was the truth.

units.source_text: 啊，真想讓她看看那些畫，我如此徒勞地煩悶著。

en.t: Ah, how I wanted to show her those paintings, and so I tormented myself in vain.

units.source_text: 突然間，我心思一轉，放棄原來的念頭。

en.t: Suddenly my thoughts shifted, and I gave up on my original idea.

units.source_text: 「漫畫，至少畫漫畫，我覺得比堀木強。」

en.t: Comics, at least when it comes to drawing comics, I think I am better than Horiki.

units.source_text: 我這一句敷衍的玩笑話，沒想到讓她信以為真。

en.t: To my surprise, she took that evasive little joke of mine seriously.
Yes, actually I admire you quite a bit.

units.source_text: 你平時給茂子畫的那些漫畫，我看了都忍不住笑。

en.t: Those comics you always draw for Shigeko make me laugh in spite of myself.
